# opnsense_kea_dhcpv4_subnet (Data Source)

Reads an existing Kea DHCPv4 subnet by UUID. Advanced field parity was verified with OPNsense 26.7.7 or newer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opnsense_kea_dhcpv4_subnet" "lan" {
  id = "12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID to look up.

### Read-Only

- `allocator` (String) Address allocator.
- `auto_collect` (Boolean) Automatically collect option data from OPNsense.
- `description` (String) Description of the subnet.
- `dns_servers` (Set of String) IPv4 DNS servers offered to clients.
- `domain_name` (String) Domain name offered to clients.
- `domain_search` (Set of String) Domain-search suffixes offered to clients.
- `match_client_id` (Boolean) Match clients by client-id.
- `next_server` (String) Network-boot next-server address.
- `ntp_servers` (Set of String) IPv4 NTP servers offered to clients.
- `ping_check` (Boolean) Ping the address before handing out a lease.
- `pools` (String) DHCPv4 pool definitions.
- `routers` (Set of String) IPv4 default routers offered to clients.
- `static_routes` (Attributes Set) IPv4 static route pairs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--static_routes))
- `subnet` (String) IPv4 subnet in CIDR notation.
- `tftp_bootfile` (String) Network boot filename.
- `tftp_server` (String) TFTP server name or address.
- `time_servers` (Set of String) IPv4 RFC 868 time servers offered to clients.

### Nested Schema for `static_routes`

Read-Only:

- `destination` (String) IPv4 route destination.
- `router` (String) IPv4 next-hop router.
